summary: @arasbozkurt Not sure I agree that metadata is the great savior of the web. #el30 Problem we tried to increase capacity by simplifying design in large silos rather than letting the open web flourish. What we do now, beyond some new html5 tags, not really that different.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @arasbozkurt Not sure I agree that metadata is the great savior of the web. #el30 Problem we tried to increase capacity by simplifying design in large silos rather than letting the open web flourish. What we do now, beyond some new html5 tags, not really that different.
